answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and an authenticated beacon, so coordinated equivocation by k identities triggers correlated penalties of O(k^2), not merely k independent fines. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, making large covert coalitions economically irrational: a sparrow-sized cluster may survive minor faults, but a dune-scale operation rapidly exhausts escrowed funds and depreciating stake.
